h: Viral video of Wizkid's father in the trenches splits fans
p: A viral clip said to show Wizkid's father in the trenches has sparked a fierce argument between fans online. An old post by the singer about his father has resurfaced in the row.
more: Fans on both sides have been trading posts on X and Instagram.
Wizkid has not been reported to have commented on the clip.
